mass satur day october 24th 6.0 0 p.m. eileen leufer, ballygaddy road. satur day october 31st 6.0 0 p.m. jacqueline collins , bermingham road. tuam charity car wash – the organisers of the charity car wash at o’connor’s fuels, which took place on saturday 19th september would like to say a big thank you to all who donated to our successful car wash. the proceeds of the car wash go to tuam cancer care & galway hospice. thanks to all who sponsored the event and volunteered on the day. the children’s rosary is a global organisation - dedicated to bringing children together in prayer. we are delighted to announce the launch of a new group in tuam commencing friday, 27th november at 6.30 pm. please note that all children must be accompanied by an adult for the duration of the rosary. all families are warmly welcome to attend. eucharistic ministers — all current eucharistic ministers in the parish are warmly invited to an enrichment and information evening in the parish centre on wednesday, november 4th, at 8.00 pm. the evening will be facilitated by niamh morris, and will follow up on several matters raised at the eucharistic ministers’ meeting on june 2nd. we look forward to welcoming all eucharistic ministers to what is hoped will be an informative and enriching evening. barmbrack hospitality in the parish centre - the parish pastoral council invite you to a tea/coffee & barmbrack (an bairí n breac) morning in the parish centre after 10.00 mass on tuesday 27th october. we look forward to seeing you there to mark halloween, a little early, before we begin the month of the holy souls. novena for the faithful departed a novena of masses will be offered in the cathedral from november 1st - 9th for the happy repose of the souls of the
